description_en: Retrieves the progress of an export task
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem get-export-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --export-id 200013 --role-for 1130916744880000 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetExportTask

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is deployed. Select a region based on your asset location. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the export task
parameters.name: export_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of a member account. An administrator can use this parameter to operate as the specified member account
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for
